headline: Grindrod Completes First Private Train Test Run on Transnet Network
summary: Grindrod has successfully completed a test run as the first private train operator on South Africa's national freight rail network managed by Transnet. This marks a significant milestone in the privatization of rail logistics in the country.
why: The opening of state-owned rail infrastructure to private operators is a major structural reform aimed at improving logistics efficiency and reducing bottlenecks for commodity exports.

impacts.name: Grindrod
impacts.why: Access to national rail infrastructure provides a new revenue opportunity for the private operator.
